args.title: payments-api degraded after v5.1.0 deploy
args.summary: payments-api is unhealthy (18% error rate) in all regions after this morning's v5.1.0 deploy. Rolling back to previously healthy v5.0.0.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Identified the service**: The service is `payments-api` (the name "payments" wasn't recognized). It was running v5.1.0 in all regions, unhealthy with an 18% error rate.

2. **Confirmed the bad deploy**: Deployment history showed v5.0.0 was the last healthy release, and v5.1.0 (this morning's deploy) was degraded.

3. **Rolled back**: Rolled `payments-api` back to v5.0.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Verified post-rollback: service is healthy with a 0.2% error rate.

4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("payments-api degraded after v5.1.0 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer.

Note: The rollback to v5.0.0 was a previously healthy production version, so no change-manager approval was required.
